_comment: Normative keywords per language. Only a bold keyword (**must**) carries normative force. warnUnbolded: report a plain keyword inside a rule; off where words have no boundaries. formCondition: the bold opening word of a form-conditional rule (**Where** …), a declared leak of form into the spec. hiddenForce: words that carry force without a keyword (cannot, is refused, never…); lint warns when a rule uses one and carries no bold keyword.
